title: Private Health Insurance (National Joint Replacement Register Levy) Amendment Bill 2026
short_title: Private Health Insurance (National Joint Replacement Register Levy) Amendment Bill 2026

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would remove the annual $5,000 ceiling on the levy charged for each listed medical device to fund the National Joint Replacement Registry.
Removing that ceiling would allow the levy to be distributed among medical device companies in proportion to the number of devices they actually supply.
The change would apply from the financial year starting 1 July 2027, with the registry continuing to receive funding through a Commonwealth grants agreement.
changes: The existing statutory levy ceiling would be repealed by removing subsection 7(3).
The amendment would take effect on the 28th day after Royal Assent.
The uncapped levy would apply from the financial year beginning on 1 July 2027.
summary.affected: Medical device companies that pay the National Joint Replacement Register levy are affected.
